project: Emmy Noether multilingual Slavic translation/register lane
status: source-fidelity language-lane update and linguistics apparatus; not source-certified Noether closure
coverage: Package-declared Noether Slavic lane update with Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic Latin, and deterministic Interslavic Cyrillic materials. It includes Paper01-43 cumulative TeX/PDF readers according to the package manifest, plus standalone source-fidelity endmatter readers for Post45 Kapferer-Noether and the terminal bibliography.
canonical_cumulative_scope: Paper01-43 cumulative Slavic readers are present as package-declared language-lane artifacts. Post45 and the terminal bibliography remain standalone until Post44 is translated and the endmatter can be appended in source order.
source_decision_notes: The package records a source-visible Post45 wording issue where source prose says A and psi but the mathematical identity requires A and B; the translations normalize to A/B and leave the decision review-visible.
The Interslavic Latin branch and deterministic Cyrillic reader branch are part of the scholarly artifact and should be preserved with the logs, glossaries, segment data, and conversion notes.
The German witness is a local TeX/page-block witness for translation control, not a critical edition.
public_caveats: This is a multilingual translation/register-construction and linguistics apparatus update, not a certified critical edition.
Do not treat this package as independent certification of the German source line or as source-closed Noether corpus completion.
The Post45 and terminal-bibliography endmatter readers are standalone until Post44 is translated and endmatter order can be rebuilt deliberately.
Downstream mathematical use still requires checking important formulas, tables, footnotes, citations, and translation-sensitive terminology against source witnesses.
